## Objective

Phase 0 of `planning/gfw_analysis_plan.qmd`: turn the zero-filled **Primary**
cell tables from `04_classify_aggregate.qmd` into one tidy analysis table per
dataset × time step, keyed on `cell_id`, with every derived field the later
phases use, plus the static cell covariates (lease distance, gear domains,
bathymetry), the Ørsted infrastructure layers and their time-varying
exposure covariates, and the spatial weights.

Nothing here re-aggregates hours from records. The stage × season and
season-year tables are sums of the zero-filled monthly table, so every hour
reconciles exactly with 04. Records are read only for what the cell tables do
not carry: vessel counts over strata 04 did not build, and the fleet size
behind `rate_fleet`.

| Output (`data/processed/analysis/`) | One row per |
|---|---|
| `{vp,afe}_stage_gear.csv` | cell × stage × gear |
| `{vp,afe}_stage_season_gear.csv` | cell × stage × season × gear |
| `{vp,afe}_season_year_gear.csv` | cell × season-year × gear |
| `{vp,afe}_month_gear.csv` | cell × month × gear |
| `cells.gpkg` | cell: geometry (EPSG:32619) and static covariates |
| `infra_cell_month.csv`, `infra_cell_season_year.csv` | cell × month / season-year: infrastructure exposure |
| `infra_cell_month_srw_planned.csv` | cell × month: the same, with SRW's 40 unrecorded positions installed (sensitivity) |
| `grid_queen.gal`, `grid_weights.rds` | queen contiguity (GAL for GeoDa / PySAL; `listw` objects for R) |

Every output has a `<file>.json` provenance sidecar. The bathymetry subset is
stored once in `data/sf/bathy/` with its own sidecar, and fetched again only
if its hash no longer matches. The infrastructure layers (foundations and
cable routes) are written to `data/sf/infra/infrastructure.gpkg`. Fields are defined in
`references/data_dictionary.md`.

The **gate** at the end collects every check. The phase passes only if all of
them hold.

## Libraries and shared code

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(terra)

source("r/paths.R")
source("r/gfw_helpers.R")
source("r/vessel_helpers.R")
source("r/analysis_helpers.R")
source("r/infra_helpers.R")

# Quarto parameters (header); `params` is read-only while rendering. Run chunk
# by chunk, `params` is missing or left over from another session, so the
# header is read from this file directly instead
qparams <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) params else {
  hdr <- knitr::knit_params(readLines(
    file.path(root, "r/05_prepare_analysis.qmd"), warn = FALSE))
  lapply(hdr, function(p) p$value)
}
paths <- gfw_paths_with(qparams)

set.seed(42) # workflow-wide seed (plan, FAIR); nothing here is random yet

crs_utm  <- 32619 # WGS 84 / UTM zone 19N, the grid's CRS
datasets <- c("vp", "afe")

# every check the Phase 0 gate needs, filled in as the steps run
gate <- tibble(check = character(), pass = logical())
check <- function(name, ok) {
  gate <<- add_row(gate, check = name, pass = isTRUE(ok))
  invisible(ok)
}
```

## Step 1: read the gear tables

The four gear tables per dataset (stage and month, both sets). Primary is
the analysis set. Its `UNRESOLVED` rows are structural zeros, since every
Primary record has a resolved gear class, so they are dropped once they are
shown to hold no hours. Strict stays in its own object; the Strict
sensitivity runs in `13` read it from `data/interim/` directly.

```{r}
gear_table_path <- function(dataset, time) {
  file.path(paths$interim_gfw, sprintf("gfw_%s_cell_%s_gear_sets.csv", dataset, time))
}

read_gear_table <- function(dataset, time) {
  read_csv(gear_table_path(dataset, time),
           col_types = cols(cell_id = "c", set = "c", gear_class = "c",
                            n_mmsi = "i", .default = "?")) |>
    rename(hours = paste0(dataset, "_hours"))
}

interim <- list()
for (ds in datasets) for (tm in c("stage", "month")) {
  interim[[ds]][[tm]] <- read_gear_table(ds, tm)
}

unresolved <- map_dfr(datasets, \(ds) map_dfr(c("stage", "month"), \(tm)
  interim[[ds]][[tm]] |>
    filter(set == "primary", gear_class == "UNRESOLVED") |>
    summarise(dataset = ds, table = tm, hours = sum(hours))))
unresolved
check("Primary UNRESOLVED rows hold 0 h", all(unresolved$hours == 0))

primary <- map(interim, \(d) map(d, \(t) filter(t, set == "primary", gear_class %in% analysis_gears) |>
                                   select(-set)))
strict  <- map(interim, \(d) map(d, \(t) filter(t, set == "strict") |> select(-set)))
```

## Step 2: grid attributes and the calendar

The calendar is one row per month of the analysis window, with every time
label the tables need. The month counts per stratum (`months`) come from it.

```{r}
grid <- st_read(paths$grid, quiet = TRUE)
stopifnot("grid is not in EPSG:32619" = st_crs(grid)$epsg == crs_utm)

# centroid coordinates in km, for the spatial fields and the SPDE mesh
ctr <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(grid)))
grid_attr <- st_drop_geometry(grid) |>
  transmute(cell_id, area_km2, aoi_class,
            x_km = ctr[, "X"] / 1000, y_km = ctr[, "Y"] / 1000)

calendar <- tibble(year_month = seq(analysis_start, analysis_end, by = "month")) |>
  mutate(stage       = stage_of(year_month),
         season      = season_of(year_month),
         season_year = season_year_of(year_month),
         moy         = as.integer(format(year_month, "%m")),
         year        = as.integer(format(year_month, "%Y")),
         t_index     = row_number())

stopifnot("stage lengths differ from dev_stages" =
            identical(as.integer(table(calendar$stage)[dev_stages$stage]), dev_stages$months))

# months per stratum, for `rate`, `density` and `log_expo`
months_stage        <- count(calendar, stage, name = "months")
months_stage_season <- count(calendar, stage, season, name = "months")
months_season_year  <- count(calendar, stage, season, season_year, name = "months")

months_stage_season |> pivot_wider(names_from = season, values_from = months)

# no stage × season stratum or season-year spans two stages
check("no season-year spans two stages",
      nrow(months_season_year) == nrow(distinct(calendar, season, season_year)))
check("22 season-years", nrow(months_season_year) == 22)
check("monthly tables cover every month of the window",
      all(map_lgl(primary, \(d) setequal(unique(d$month$`Year Month`), calendar$year_month))))
```

## Step 3: time-step tables and derived fields

### The monthly table and its sums

```{r}
month_tbl <- map(primary, \(d) d$month |>
  rename(year_month = `Year Month`) |>
  left_join(calendar, by = "year_month"))

# stage × season and season-year: sums of the zero-filled monthly table
sum_months <- function(m, keys) {
  m |> group_by(across(all_of(c("cell_id", "gear_class", keys)))) |>
    summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop")
}

stage_tbl <- map(primary, \(d) d$stage |> rename(stage = `Development Stage`))
stage_season_tbl <- map(month_tbl, sum_months, keys = c("stage", "season"))
season_year_tbl  <- map(month_tbl, sum_months, keys = c("stage", "season", "season_year"))

# 04's stage table must equal the monthly table summed by stage, cell by cell
stage_vs_month <- map2_dbl(stage_tbl, month_tbl, \(s, m)
  s |> inner_join(sum_months(m, "stage"), by = c("cell_id", "gear_class", "stage")) |>
    with(max(abs(hours.x - hours.y))))
stage_vs_month
check("stage table = monthly table summed by stage, every cell", all(stage_vs_month < 1e-6))
```

### Records: vessel counts and fleet size

The cell tables carry `n_mmsi` per row, but distinct counts do not sum, so
stage × season and season-year vessel counts come from the Primary records.
The records are first shown to reproduce the monthly table exactly.

`n_mmsi_fleet` is the number of distinct Primary MMSIs per gear active
anywhere in the AOI in the time step (caveat 5). It is an AOI count, so it can
itself respond to the projects (vessels leaving the AOI lower it); a regional
count from outside the AOI would avoid that and stays an open item.

```{r}
records_path <- \(ds) file.path(paths$processed_gfw, sprintf("gfw_%s_id_classified.csv", ds))

records <- map(set_names(datasets), \(ds)
  read_csv(records_path(ds), col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
    filter(in_primary == "TRUE") |>
    transmute(cell_id, MMSI, gear_class, hours = as.numeric(hours),
              year_month = as.Date(`Year Month`)) |>
    left_join(calendar, by = "year_month"))

rec_vs_month <- map2_dbl(records, month_tbl, \(r, m)
  m |> full_join(sum_months(r, "year_month"), by = c("cell_id", "gear_class", "year_month")) |>
    mutate(across(starts_with("hours"), \(x) coalesce(x, 0))) |>
    with(max(abs(hours.x - hours.y))))
rec_vs_month
check("Primary records reproduce the monthly table, every cell × month × gear",
      all(rec_vs_month < 1e-6))

# per-cell vessel counts for the strata 04 did not build
n_mmsi_cell <- function(r, keys) {
  r |> group_by(across(all_of(c("cell_id", "gear_class", keys)))) |>
    summarise(n_mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop")
}

# AOI-wide fleet size per gear and time step
n_mmsi_fleet <- function(r, keys) {
  r |> group_by(across(all_of(c("gear_class", keys)))) |>
    summarise(n_mmsi_fleet = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop")
}

# the record counts must agree with 04's per-cell stage counts
mmsi_vs_stage <- map2_lgl(records, stage_tbl, \(r, s)
  s |> left_join(n_mmsi_cell(r, "stage"), by = c("cell_id", "gear_class", "stage")) |>
    with(all(n_mmsi.x == coalesce(n_mmsi.y, 0L))))
check("record vessel counts match 04's cell × stage counts", all(mmsi_vs_stage))

map_dfr(records, \(r) n_mmsi_fleet(r, "stage"), .id = "dataset") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = stage, values_from = n_mmsi_fleet)
```

### Derived fields

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| `months` | months in the stratum |
| `rate` | `hours / months` |
| `rate_fleet` | `hours / (months × n_mmsi_fleet)`; level comparisons only |
| `density` | `hours / (months × area_km2)`, h km⁻² month⁻¹ |
| `log_expo` | `log(months × area_km2)`, the model offset |
| `y_vst` | √`density` (VP) or `log(density + c)` (AFE), per surface |
| `rate_std` | stage tables: mean of the 12 month-of-year mean rates |

A surface, for `y_vst`, is one dataset × gear × time-step value: one map.

```{r}
add_derived <- function(tbl, ds, surface_keys) {
  tbl |>
    left_join(grid_attr, by = "cell_id") |>
    mutate(rate     = hours / months,
           rate_fleet = if_else(n_mmsi_fleet > 0, hours / (months * n_mmsi_fleet), NA_real_),
           density  = hours / (months * area_km2),
           log_expo = log(months * area_km2)) |>
    group_by(across(all_of(c("gear_class", surface_keys)))) |>
    mutate(y_vst = vst_density(density, ds)) |>
    ungroup()
}

# season-standardised stage rate, per cell × gear × stage (caveat 8)
rate_std_tbl <- map(month_tbl, \(m) m |>
  group_by(cell_id, gear_class, stage) |>
  summarise(rate_std = rate_std_of(hours, moy), .groups = "drop"))

analysis <- list()
for (ds in datasets) {
  r <- records[[ds]]
  analysis[[ds]] <- list(
    stage = stage_tbl[[ds]] |>
      left_join(months_stage, by = "stage") |>
      left_join(n_mmsi_fleet(r, "stage"), by = c("gear_class", "stage")) |>
      left_join(rate_std_tbl[[ds]], by = c("cell_id", "gear_class", "stage")) |>
      add_derived(ds, "stage"),
    stage_season = stage_season_tbl[[ds]] |>
      left_join(months_stage_season, by = c("stage", "season")) |>
      left_join(n_mmsi_cell(r, c("stage", "season")), by = c("cell_id", "gear_class", "stage", "season")) |>
      left_join(n_mmsi_fleet(r, c("stage", "season")), by = c("gear_class", "stage", "season")) |>
      add_derived(ds, c("stage", "season")),
    season_year = season_year_tbl[[ds]] |>
      left_join(months_season_year, by = c("stage", "season", "season_year")) |>
      left_join(n_mmsi_cell(r, c("season", "season_year")), by = c("cell_id", "gear_class", "season", "season_year")) |>
      left_join(n_mmsi_fleet(r, c("season", "season_year")), by = c("gear_class", "season", "season_year")) |>
      add_derived(ds, c("season", "season_year")),
    month = month_tbl[[ds]] |>
      mutate(months = 1L) |>
      left_join(n_mmsi_fleet(r, "year_month"), by = c("gear_class", "year_month")) |>
      add_derived(ds, "year_month"))

  # zero-filled strata: no vessel record means 0 vessels, not missing
  analysis[[ds]] <- map(analysis[[ds]], \(t) mutate(t,
    across(any_of(c("n_mmsi", "n_mmsi_fleet")), \(x) coalesce(as.integer(x), 0L))))
}

# season-standardised vs raw AOI stage rates, the caveat 8 table, recomputed
map_dfr(analysis, \(d) d$stage |>
  group_by(gear_class, stage) |>
  summarise(bias_pct = round(100 * (sum(rate) / sum(rate_std) - 1), 1), .groups = "drop"),
  .id = "dataset") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = stage, values_from = bias_pct)
```

## Step 4: lease distances

Signed distance from each cell centroid to the nearest lease boundary
(negative inside a lease), the BAG distance band, and the nearest project.
The leases are stored in EPSG:3857 and reprojected first.

```{r}
leases <- map_dfr(paths$leases, \(f) st_read(f, quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(crs_utm) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) |>
  mutate(project = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))))

round(set_names(as.numeric(st_area(leases)) / 1e6, leases$project), 1)

cell_dist <- lease_distance(st_centroid(st_geometry(grid)) |> st_sf(), leases) |>
  mutate(cell_id = grid$cell_id,
         dist_band = dist_band_of(dist_lease_km), .before = 1)

count(cell_dist, dist_band)
count(cell_dist, nearest_project)

check("every cell within 15 km of a lease", max(cell_dist$dist_lease_km) <= 15)
check("at least 280 cells in every distance band", min(table(cell_dist$dist_band)) >= 280)
```

## Step 5: gear domains

Each gear's model domain is the cells where it was active in **Stage 1**,
never the whole series: a domain drawn from all stages would drop cells
abandoned because of the projects, conditioning on the outcome (caveat 13).
The domain is per dataset, since a cell can see VP but no AFE.

```{r}
domains <- map_dfr(analysis, \(d) d$stage |>
  filter(stage == "Stage 1") |>
  transmute(cell_id, gear_class, domain = hours > 0), .id = "dataset")

domains |> group_by(dataset, gear_class) |> summarise(cells = sum(domain), .groups = "drop")

domain_wide <- domains |>
  mutate(col = paste("domain", dataset, str_to_lower(gear_class), sep = "_")) |>
  select(cell_id, col, domain) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = domain)

for (ds in datasets) {
  analysis[[ds]] <- map(analysis[[ds]], \(t) t |>
    left_join(filter(domains, dataset == ds) |> select(-dataset),
              by = c("cell_id", "gear_class")))
}
```

## Step 6: bathymetry

NCEI Coastal Relief Model Vol. 1 (2023, 1 arc-second, EGM2008 metres,
negative down), fetched as a GeoTIFF subset over the grid's bounding box plus
5 km through THREDDS WCS. The stored file is reused while its hash matches
the sidecar written when it was fetched.

Per-cell covariates, all area-weighted (`exact = TRUE`):

- `depth_m`, `depth_sd_m`: mean and SD of depth at 30 m (SD is a rugosity
  proxy);
- `slope_deg`: mean slope at 30 m;
- `bpi_broad`: broad-scale bathymetric position index, elevation minus its
  mean in a 1–3 km annulus, so **positive = ridges and banks, negative =
  troughs**. It is computed on a 150 m aggregate, because a 3 km annulus at
  30 m is a 201 × 201 window over millions of pixels, and a 1–3 km index
  gains nothing from 30 m detail.

```{r}
# grid bounding box + 5 km, in lon/lat, rounded outward to 0.01°
bb <- st_bbox(st_transform(st_buffer(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(grid)), 5000), 4326))
bb <- c(floor(bb[c("xmin", "ymin")] * 100), ceiling(bb[c("xmax", "ymax")] * 100)) / 100
crm_url <- paste0(qparams$crm_wcs,
                  "?service=WCS&version=1.0.0&request=GetCoverage&coverage=z",
                  "&format=GeoTIFF_Float&bbox=",
                  paste(bb[c("xmin", "ymin", "xmax", "ymax")], collapse = ","))

bathy_side <- paste0(paths$bathy, ".json")
bathy_ok <- file.exists(paths$bathy) && file.exists(bathy_side) &&
  identical(jsonlite::read_json(bathy_side)$output_sha256, file_sha256(paths$bathy)) &&
  identical(jsonlite::read_json(bathy_side)$request_url, crm_url)

if (!bathy_ok) {
  dir.create(dirname(paths$bathy), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  download.file(crm_url, paths$bathy, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  write_provenance(paths$bathy, inputs = character(), extra = list(
    source = "NOAA NCEI U.S. Coastal Relief Model Vol. 1 (Northeast Atlantic), 2023, 1 arc-second",
    request_url = crm_url, accessed = format(Sys.Date()),
    vertical_datum = "EGM2008 (EPSG:3855), metres, positive up",
    licence = "US Government work, public domain"))
}
message(if (bathy_ok) "Bathymetry: stored subset reused (hash matches)" else "Bathymetry: subset fetched")

crm <- rast(paths$bathy)
crm
stopifnot("CRM subset is not lon/lat WGS 84" = same.crs(crm, "EPSG:4326"))

# elevation (positive up) in UTM at 30 m; depth = -elevation
utm_template <- rast(ext(project(crm, paste0("EPSG:", crs_utm))), resolution = 30,
                     crs = paste0("EPSG:", crs_utm))
elev  <- project(crm, utm_template, method = "bilinear")
depth <- -elev
slope <- terrain(elev, v = "slope", unit = "degrees")

# broad BPI on a 150 m aggregate with a 1–3 km annulus
elev150 <- aggregate(elev, fact = 5, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
r_out <- ceiling(3000 / res(elev150)[1])
dd <- outer(seq(-r_out, r_out), seq(-r_out, r_out), \(i, j) sqrt(i^2 + j^2)) * res(elev150)[1]
annulus <- (dd >= 1000 & dd <= 3000) * 1
# annulus mean = sum of elevations / number of non-missing pixels in the
# annulus, so pixels near the raster edge average over what is there
ann_sum <- focal(elev150, w = annulus, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
ann_n   <- focal(!is.na(elev150), w = annulus, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
bpi <- elev150 - ann_sum / ann_n

# area-weighted per-cell summaries
cells_v <- vect(select(grid, cell_id))
wmean <- \(x, w) sum(x * w) / sum(w)
wsd   <- \(x, w) sqrt(sum(w * (x - wmean(x, w))^2) / sum(w))

fine30 <- c(depth, slope)
names(fine30) <- c("depth", "slope")
names(bpi) <- "bpi"
ex30 <- extract(fine30, cells_v, exact = TRUE) |>
  as_tibble() |> filter(!is.na(depth), !is.na(slope))
ex150 <- extract(bpi, cells_v, exact = TRUE) |>
  as_tibble() |> filter(!is.na(bpi))

bathy_cells <- ex30 |>
  group_by(ID) |>
  summarise(depth_m = wmean(depth, fraction), depth_sd_m = wsd(depth, fraction),
            slope_deg = wmean(slope, fraction), .groups = "drop") |>
  full_join(ex150 |> group_by(ID) |>
              summarise(bpi_broad = wmean(bpi, fraction), .groups = "drop"), by = "ID") |>
  mutate(cell_id = grid$cell_id[ID], .keep = "unused")

summary(select(bathy_cells, -cell_id))

check("every cell has depth, slope and BPI",
      nrow(bathy_cells) == nrow(grid) && !anyNA(bathy_cells))
check("every depth is positive (the AOI does not touch land)", all(bathy_cells$depth_m > 0))
check("depths within the shelf range (< 200 m)", all(bathy_cells$depth_m < 200))
```

## Step 7: spatial weights

Queen contiguity built twice, from the cell polygons (`poly2nb()`, as in 02)
and from the integer lattice (`lattice_nb()`), and checked to be identical,
so no floating-point sliver in the geometry has added or dropped a link.

- `lw_W`: row-standardised, for Moran's I and local Moran's I.
- `lw_B_self`: binary with the cell itself included, for Gi\*. General G's
  binary weights without self are built in Phase 2.

```{r}
# row.names = cell_id, so the GAL file and the nb object name cells by key
nb_poly    <- poly2nb(grid, row.names = grid$cell_id, queen = TRUE, snap = 0)
nb_lattice <- lattice_nb(grid$ix, grid$iy, grid$cell_id)

summary(card(nb_poly))

check("poly2nb and lattice neighbours identical",
      isTRUE(all.equal(nb_poly, nb_lattice, check.attributes = FALSE)))
check("one connected component", n.comp.nb(nb_poly)$nc == 1)
check("no islands", all(card(nb_poly) > 0))
check("mean neighbour count above 7.7", mean(card(nb_poly)) > 7.7)

lw_W      <- nb2listw(nb_poly, style = "W")
lw_B_self <- nb2listw(include.self(nb_poly), style = "B")
```

## Step 8: infrastructure and exposure covariates

The Ørsted turbine and cable data (plan, "Ørsted turbine and cable data")
come from three kinds of source, all read only:

| Project | Positions | Installation dates | Cables |
|---|---|---|---|
| SFW | layout GeoJSON (13 points) | PSO report Table 3, transcribed to `references/sfw_foundation_dates.csv` | layout routes; works window from the PSO report |
| RWF | layout GeoJSON (67 points) | Ørsted foundation CSV (65 WTG + 3 OSS foundations) | layout routes; inter-array works from 2025-11 (open) |
| SRW | preliminary layout GeoJSON (85 points) | Ørsted foundation CSV (44 WTG + the OCS-DC jacket's 8 pin piles) | layout routes; no works dates |

Rules, each decided on 2026-10-19:

- **Multi-day installations.** The foundation CSVs give one row per
  installation day, repeating the foundation's other fields. A foundation's
  `foundation_installed` is its first day and `foundation_end` its last, and
  its repeated rows must agree on structure, position and depth.
- **SFW turbines** have no published crosswalk from the PSO report's ids
  (A01–A15) to the layout positions (the COP gives none). The substation (Z01)
  sits on **AP06**, where the export cable lands, so it keeps its exact dates;
  the 12 turbines share the turbine window (2023-07-02 to 2023-08-07), with
  `date_basis = "project_window"`.
- **SRW's 40 layout positions with no installation record** are `planned`:
  work stopped in December 2025 and the January–April piling moratorium
  followed, so they never count as installed here. A sensitivity table
  treats them as installed in `srw_planned_from` (May 2026).
- **Cables** are static routes, plus coarse project × cable-type works
  windows from `references/infra_cable_windows.csv`. A window with no start
  (`complete_by`, `unknown`) never switches `cable_works` on.
- RWF and SRW positions take the CSV (as-installed) coordinates,
  checked against the layout points; SRW's layout names are truncated, so
  its positions are matched by distance.

Per cell × month covariates, from cell centroids:

| Covariate | Definition |
|---|---|
| `d_found_km` | distance to the nearest foundation (turbine or substation) installed by the end of the month; NA before the first |
| `n_found_2km` | installed foundations within `r_count_km` |
| `active_construction` | a foundation's installation days overlap the month within `r_active_km` |
| `cable_works` | a cable route whose works window overlaps the month lies within `r_cable_km` |
| `phase` | the nearest project's `pre` / `construction` / `post_construction` |
| `months_since_first_found` | months from the nearest project's first foundation (event time) |

Substations count with turbines because a jacket or monopile is the same
seabed obstruction to gear. Two static covariates join `cells.gpkg` and every
table: `d_found_final_km` (nearest eventual foundation, planned included) and
`d_cable_km` (nearest cable route). The season-year table averages the
distances and counts over the season's months, gives the flags as shares of
months, and takes the phase held in most months.

### Sources

```{r}
# Foundation CSVs (RWF, SRW): one row per installation day, collapsed to one
# row per foundation spanning its first to last day (read_foundation_csv())
rwf_sheet <- read_foundation_csv(paths$rwf_foundations)
srw_sheet <- read_foundation_csv(paths$srw_foundations)

# SFW: the PSO report's monopile dates (Table 3), transcribed
sfw_dates <- read_csv(paths$sfw_foundations, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
  mutate(across(ends_with("_date"), as.Date))

# Layout files: every planned or built position (points) and cable route
# (lines). The 2-letter + 2-digit grid name (e.g. AM06) is the position key.
read_layout <- function(f, prj, type) {
  g <- st_read(f, quiet = TRUE)
  g[st_geometry_type(g) == type, ] |>
    transmute(project = prj, layout_name = str_squish(name), description) |>
    st_transform(crs_utm)
}
layout_pts <- imap_dfr(paths$layouts, \(f, prj) read_layout(f, prj, "POINT")) |>
  mutate(grid_pos = str_extract(layout_name, "^[A-Z]{2}\\d{2}"))
layout_lines <- imap_dfr(paths$layouts, \(f, prj) read_layout(f, prj, "LINESTRING"))
# version date of each layout file, from its name (e.g. ..._26-01-19.geojson)
layout_version <- map_chr(paths$layouts, \(f) format(as.Date(
  str_extract(basename(f), "\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}(?=\\.geojson$)"), format = "%y-%m-%d")))

cable_windows <- read_csv(paths$cable_windows, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
  mutate(across(c(lay_start, lay_end), as.Date))

count(st_drop_geometry(layout_pts), project, name = "positions")
check("layout grid names parse and are unique within each project",
      !anyNA(layout_pts$grid_pos) && !anyDuplicated(paste(layout_pts$project, layout_pts$grid_pos)))
```

### Foundations and cables

```{r}
# CSV coordinates (WGS 84) -> UTM points
sheet_sf <- \(d) st_as_sf(d, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |> st_transform(crs_utm)

# RWF: "B47/AK12" carries both the internal id and the grid position
rwf <- rwf_sheet |>
  mutate(internal_id = str_extract(foundation_id, "^[^/]+"),
         grid_pos = str_extract(foundation_id, "(?<=/)[A-Z]{2}\\d{2}"),
         asset_type = if_else(str_detect(structure, "OSS"), "oss", "wtg")) |>
  sheet_sf()
rwf_lay <- filter(layout_pts, project == "RWF")
rwf$layout_offset_m <- as.numeric(st_distance(
  rwf, rwf_lay[match(rwf$grid_pos, rwf_lay$grid_pos), ], by_element = TRUE))

# SRW: the converter station's 8 jacket pin piles become one foundation
srw_pins <- filter(srw_sheet, str_detect(foundation_id, "Pin Pile"))
srw <- srw_sheet |>
  filter(!str_detect(foundation_id, "Pin Pile")) |>
  mutate(asset_type = "wtg") |>
  bind_rows(srw_pins |> summarise(
    foundation_id = "OCS-DC", structure = "OCS-DC jacket (8 pin piles)",
    foundation_installed = min(foundation_installed), foundation_end = max(foundation_end),
    n_date_rows = sum(n_date_rows), lat = mean(lat), lon = mean(lon),
    depth_m = mean(depth_m), asset_type = "oss")) |>
  mutate(internal_id = foundation_id) |>
  sheet_sf()
# SRW layout names are truncated ("AS03 (C0"), so positions match by distance
srw_lay <- filter(layout_pts, project == "SRW")
srw_nn <- nearest_point(srw, srw_lay)
srw <- mutate(srw, grid_pos = srw_lay$grid_pos[srw_nn$b_row], layout_offset_m = srw_nn$dist_m)

# SFW: the export cable lands on AP06, so AP06 is the substation (Z01). The
# PSO report's turbine ids (A01–A15) have no published crosswalk to grid
# positions, so the 12 turbines share the project's turbine window.
sfw_wtg <- filter(sfw_dates, structure == "WTG")
sfw_oss <- filter(sfw_dates, structure == "OSS")
sfw <- filter(layout_pts, project == "SFW") |>
  mutate(asset_type = if_else(grid_pos == "AP06", "oss", "wtg"),
         internal_id = if_else(asset_type == "oss", sfw_oss$pso_id, NA_character_),
         foundation_installed = if_else(asset_type == "oss", sfw_oss$first_date, min(sfw_wtg$first_date)),
         foundation_end = if_else(asset_type == "oss", sfw_oss$last_date, max(sfw_wtg$last_date)),
         layout_offset_m = 0)

# SRW positions with no installation record: planned (decision 2026-10-19)
srw_planned <- srw_lay |> filter(!grid_pos %in% srw$grid_pos) |>
  mutate(asset_type = "wtg", layout_offset_m = 0)

foundations <- bind_rows(
  rwf |> mutate(project = "RWF", date_basis = "exact", source = basename(paths$rwf_foundations),
                version_date = layout_version[["RWF"]]),
  srw |> mutate(project = "SRW", date_basis = "exact", source = basename(paths$srw_foundations),
                version_date = layout_version[["SRW"]]),
  sfw |> mutate(date_basis = if_else(asset_type == "oss", "exact", "project_window"),
                source = paste(basename(paths$sfw_foundations), "+", basename(paths$layouts[["SFW"]])),
                version_date = layout_version[["SFW"]]),
  srw_planned |> mutate(date_basis = "planned", source = basename(paths$layouts[["SRW"]]),
                        version_date = layout_version[["SRW"]])) |>
  mutate(asset_id = paste(project, coalesce(internal_id, grid_pos), sep = "-"),
         status = if_else(is.na(foundation_end), "planned", "installed"),
         # not supplied by Ørsted yet; kept so the layer has the plan's schema
         wtg_installed = as.Date(NA), first_power = as.Date(NA)) |>
  select(asset_id, project, asset_type, grid_pos, internal_id, status, date_basis,
         foundation_installed, foundation_end, n_date_rows, wtg_installed, first_power,
         depth_m, layout_offset_m, source, version_date)

foundations |> st_drop_geometry() |> count(project, asset_type, status)

# Cable routes as drawn in the layout files, with their project × type works
# window. An open window runs to the end of the analysis window.
cables <- layout_lines |>
  mutate(asset_type = if_else(str_detect(description, "Export"), "export_cable", "iac")) |>
  left_join(cable_windows, by = c("project", "asset_type")) |>
  mutate(asset_id = paste(project, asset_type, layout_name, sep = "-"),
         lay_end = if_else(date_basis == "open_window", analysis_end, lay_end),
         burial_complete = as.Date(NA),
         version_date = layout_version[project]) |>
  select(asset_id, project, asset_type, route_name = layout_name, lay_start, lay_end,
         burial_complete, date_basis, source, version_date)

st_drop_geometry(cables) |> count(project, asset_type, date_basis)

dated <- filter(foundations, status == "installed")
exact <- filter(dated, date_basis == "exact")
check("foundation counts: SFW 13, RWF 68 (65 WTG + 3 OSS), SRW 85 positions",
      identical(as.integer(table(foundations$project)[c("SFW", "RWF", "SRW")]), c(13L, 68L, 85L)))
check("SRW: 45 dated foundations (44 WTG + OCS-DC), each on its own layout position",
      sum(dated$project == "SRW") == 45 && !anyDuplicated(srw$grid_pos))
check("every CSV foundation within 100 m of its layout position",
      all(foundations$layout_offset_m < 100))
check("asset ids unique (foundations and cables)",
      !anyDuplicated(foundations$asset_id) && !anyDuplicated(cables$asset_id))
check("installation dates inside the analysis window, first <= last",
      all(dated$foundation_installed >= analysis_start & dated$foundation_end <= analysis_end &
            dated$foundation_installed <= dated$foundation_end))
# the SFW turbines' shared window is longer by design (36 days)
check("exactly dated foundations installed within 31 days",
      all(exact$foundation_end - exact$foundation_installed <= 31))
# each foundation inside its own project's lease, with 100 m tolerance for
# as-built offsets at the lease edge
in_own_lease <- map2_lgl(st_geometry(foundations), foundations$project, \(g, prj)
  as.numeric(st_distance(st_sfc(g, crs = crs_utm), filter(leases, project == prj))) <= 100)
check("every foundation inside its own project's lease", all(in_own_lease))

dir.create(dirname(paths$infra), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
st_write(foundations, paths$infra, layer = "foundations", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
st_write(cables, paths$infra, layer = "cables", quiet = TRUE)
infra_inputs <- c(paths$rwf_foundations, paths$srw_foundations, paths$sfw_foundations,
                  paths$cable_windows, unname(paths$layouts))
write_provenance(paths$infra, infra_inputs, extra = list(
  layers = c("foundations", "cables"), crs = "EPSG:32619",
  foundations = nrow(foundations), cables = nrow(cables),
  srw_planned = sum(foundations$status == "planned")))
```

### Exposure covariates

```{r}
ctr_pts <- st_centroid(st_geometry(grid))
d_fdn <- units::drop_units(st_distance(ctr_pts, foundations)) / 1000  # cells × foundations, km
d_cab <- units::drop_units(st_distance(ctr_pts, cables)) / 1000       # cells × routes, km
months <- calendar$year_month

# static: distance to the nearest eventual foundation (all positions, planned
# included) and to the nearest cable route of any project
infra_static <- tibble(cell_id = grid$cell_id,
                       d_found_final_km = apply(d_fdn, 1, min),
                       d_cable_km = apply(d_cab, 1, min))

# Project timeline. Works start on the first foundation or cable-lay day.
# They end on the last one only if every foundation is installed and every
# cable window is closed; otherwise the project is still in construction at
# the end of the window. min/max of no dates give ±Inf, reset to NA.
finite_or_na <- \(d) if_else(is.finite(d), d, as.Date(NA))
cw_tl <- cable_windows |> group_by(project) |>
  summarise(first_cable = finite_or_na(suppressWarnings(min(lay_start, na.rm = TRUE))),
            last_cable = finite_or_na(suppressWarnings(
              max(lay_end[date_basis == "project_window"], na.rm = TRUE))),
            cable_open = any(date_basis %in% c("open_window", "unknown")), .groups = "drop")
project_tl <- st_drop_geometry(foundations) |> group_by(project) |>
  summarise(first_found = min(foundation_installed, na.rm = TRUE),
            last_found = max(foundation_end, na.rm = TRUE),
            complete = all(status == "installed"), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(cw_tl, by = "project") |>
  mutate(works_start = pmin(first_found, first_cable, na.rm = TRUE),
         works_end = if_else(complete & !cable_open,
                             pmax(last_found, last_cable, na.rm = TRUE), as.Date(NA)))
project_tl

# phase and event time follow each cell's nearest project (step 4)
cell_phase <- cell_dist |> select(cell_id, nearest_project) |>
  left_join(project_tl, by = c("nearest_project" = "project")) |>
  cross_join(tibble(year_month = months)) |>
  mutate(phase = project_phase(year_month, works_start, works_end),
         months_since_first_found = months_between(year_month, first_found)) |>
  select(cell_id, year_month, phase, months_since_first_found)

# per cell × month foundation exposure, for one set of installation dates
build_exposure <- function(installed, end) {
  foundation_exposure(d_fdn, installed, end, months,
                      r_count_km = qparams$r_count_km, r_active_km = qparams$r_active_km) |>
    mutate(cell_id = grid$cell_id[cell], .keep = "unused", .before = 1)
}
cable_works <- cable_works_exposure(d_cab, cables$lay_start, cables$lay_end, months,
                                    r_km = qparams$r_cable_km)
# cells × months matrix -> long, column-major so cells vary fastest
cable_long <- tibble(cell_id = rep(grid$cell_id, length(months)),
                     year_month = rep(months, each = nrow(grid)),
                     cable_works = c(cable_works))

infra_month <- build_exposure(foundations$foundation_installed, foundations$foundation_end) |>
  left_join(cable_long, by = c("cell_id", "year_month")) |>
  left_join(cell_phase, by = c("cell_id", "year_month"))

# sensitivity: the 40 planned SRW positions installed in `srw_planned_from`
planned <- foundations$status == "planned"
sens_from <- as.Date(qparams$srw_planned_from)
infra_month_srw <- build_exposure(
  replace(foundations$foundation_installed, planned, sens_from),
  replace(foundations$foundation_end, planned, month_end(sens_from))) |>
  left_join(cable_long, by = c("cell_id", "year_month")) |>
  left_join(cell_phase, by = c("cell_id", "year_month"))

n_col <- sprintf("n_found_%gkm", qparams$r_count_km)

# season-year: means of distances and counts, share of months for the flags
# (plan, @sec-infra); the phase held in most months, ties to the later phase
phase_levels <- c("pre", "construction", "post_construction")
modal_phase <- \(p) { tab <- table(factor(p, phase_levels)); phase_levels[max(which(tab == max(tab)))] }
infra_season_year <- infra_month |>
  left_join(select(calendar, year_month, season, season_year), by = "year_month") |>
  group_by(cell_id, season, season_year) |>
  summarise(d_found_km = if (all(is.na(d_found_km))) NA_real_ else mean(d_found_km, na.rm = TRUE),
            across(all_of(n_col), mean),
            active_construction_share = mean(active_construction),
            cable_works_share = mean(cable_works),
            phase = modal_phase(phase),
            months_since_first_found = mean(months_since_first_found), .groups = "drop")

# cells exposed per month, by covariate
infra_month |> group_by(year_month) |>
  summarise(installed_nearby = sum(.data[[n_col]] > 0), active_construction = sum(active_construction),
            cable_works = sum(cable_works), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(installed_nearby + active_construction + cable_works > 0) |>
  mutate(year_month = format(year_month, "%Y-%m")) |> knitr::kable()

# exposure only ever grows: once a foundation is in, it stays in
mono <- infra_month |> arrange(cell_id, year_month) |> group_by(cell_id) |>
  summarise(na_first = all(diff(is.na(d_found_km)) <= 0),
            d_ok = all(diff(d_found_km[!is.na(d_found_km)]) <= 1e-9),
            n_ok = all(diff(.data[[n_col]]) >= 0), .groups = "drop")
check("infrastructure covariates: one row per cell × month, no gaps but d_found_km",
      nrow(infra_month) == nrow(grid) * length(months) && !anyNA(select(infra_month, -d_found_km)))
check("d_found_km never increases or returns to NA; n_found never decreases",
      all(mono$na_first & mono$d_ok & mono$n_ok))
check("installed by August 2026: SFW 13, RWF 68, SRW 45",
      identical(as.integer(table(dated$project)[c("SFW", "RWF", "SRW")]), c(13L, 68L, 45L)))
check("no exposure before SFW's first works (cable lay from 2023-03)",
      !any(infra_month$active_construction[infra_month$year_month < as.Date("2023-03-01")]) &&
        all(is.na(infra_month$d_found_km[infra_month$year_month < as.Date("2023-06-01")])))
```

## Step 9: write the outputs

Column order: keys first, then hours and vessel counts, exposure and rates,
then the cell attributes. Dates are ISO 8601 and the CSVs UTF-8.

The static cell covariates (lease distance, distance band, nearest project,
bathymetry, and the distances to the eventual foundations and cable routes)
are copied from `cells.gpkg` onto every row, so each table can be used on its
own. The time-varying infrastructure covariates (step 8) are joined to the
month and season-year tables only; the stage tables carry the static
gradient.

To keep the monthly tables from carrying full-precision doubles on every
row, these columns are **rounded when written**, each well below what the
data resolve:

| Columns | Decimals | Resolution |
|---|---:|---|
| `dist_lease_km`, `x_km`, `y_km`, `d_found_km`, `d_found_final_km`, `d_cable_km` | 3 | 1 m |
| `depth_m`, `depth_sd_m` | 3 | 1 mm |
| `area_km2` | 6 | 1 m² |
| `slope_deg`, `bpi_broad` | 4 | 0.0001°, 0.1 mm |
| `y_vst` | 6 | about 1e-6 |
| season-year means and shares (`n_found_2km`, `*_share`, `months_since_first_found`) | 3 | 1/1000 of a month's value |

Rounding happens only at the write. `density`, `log_expo`, `y_vst` and
`dist_band` are all computed from unrounded values first, so no cell changes
band. `cells.gpkg` keeps full precision; use it when exact values matter.

```{r}
dir.create(paths$analysis, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pull_date <- as.character(read_pull_date(paths))
key_cols <- list(stage = "stage", stage_season = c("stage", "season"),
                 season_year = c("stage", "season", "season_year"),
                 month = c("year_month", "stage", "season", "season_year", "moy", "year", "t_index"))
value_cols <- c("hours", "n_mmsi", "n_mmsi_fleet", "months", "rate", "rate_std",
                "rate_fleet", "density", "log_expo", "y_vst", "domain",
                "area_km2", "aoi_class", "x_km", "y_km",
                "dist_lease_km", "dist_band", "nearest_project",
                "depth_m", "depth_sd_m", "slope_deg", "bpi_broad",
                "d_found_final_km", "d_cable_km",
                # time-varying (step 8): month and season-year tables only
                "d_found_km", n_col, "active_construction", "active_construction_share",
                "cable_works", "cable_works_share", "phase", "months_since_first_found")
static_cols <- c("dist_lease_km", "dist_band", "nearest_project", "depth_m", "depth_sd_m",
                 "slope_deg", "bpi_broad", "d_found_final_km", "d_cable_km")

# static cell covariates repeated on every row, so each table stands alone
# for the phases that need distance or depth next to effort (1, 3, 5–6);
# cells.gpkg stays the single source they are copied from, at full precision
cell_static <- cell_dist |>
  mutate(dist_band = as.character(dist_band)) |>
  left_join(bathy_cells, by = "cell_id") |>
  left_join(infra_static, by = "cell_id")

# time-varying infrastructure covariates, by the keys of the table they join
infra_by_step <- list(month = list(tbl = infra_month, by = c("cell_id", "year_month")),
                      season_year = list(tbl = infra_season_year,
                                         by = c("cell_id", "season", "season_year")))

# Decimals each column is rounded to when written, applied only at the write,
# so every derived field (density, log_expo, y_vst, dist_band) is computed
# from full-precision values first. Each is far below what the data resolve,
# and it keeps full-precision doubles off ~1.3 million rows in the monthly
# tables. cells.gpkg keeps full precision.
write_digits <- c(
  dist_lease_km = 3,  # 1 m
  depth_m       = 3,  # 1 mm
  depth_sd_m    = 3,  # 1 mm
  x_km          = 3,  # 1 m
  y_km          = 3,  # 1 m
  area_km2      = 6,  # 1 m² on cells of ~0.93 km²
  slope_deg     = 4,  # 0.0001°; cell means range ~0.01–1.4°
  bpi_broad     = 4,  # 0.1 mm of relief
  y_vst         = 6,  # ~1e-6 on values of order 0.01–10; no effect on the spatial statistics
  d_found_km    = 3,  # 1 m
  d_found_final_km = 3,  # 1 m
  d_cable_km    = 3,  # 1 m
  # season-year means and shares (integers and flags in the monthly table are
  # unchanged by rounding)
  active_construction_share = 3, cable_works_share = 3,
  months_since_first_found = 3)
write_digits[[n_col]] <- 3
# round only the columns a table has (the infrastructure columns are not in all)
round_written <- \(t) mutate(t, across(any_of(names(write_digits)),
                                       \(x) round(x, write_digits[[cur_column()]])))

inputs_of <- \(ds) c(gear_table_path(ds, "stage"), gear_table_path(ds, "month"),
                     records_path(ds), paths$grid)

written <- tibble(file = character(), rows = integer())
for (ds in datasets) for (tm in names(key_cols)) {
  out <- analysis[[ds]][[tm]] |>
    left_join(cell_static, by = "cell_id")
  if (tm %in% names(infra_by_step)) {
    out <- left_join(out, infra_by_step[[tm]]$tbl, by = infra_by_step[[tm]]$by)
  }
  out <- out |>
    round_written() |>
    select(cell_id, gear_class, all_of(key_cols[[tm]]), any_of(value_cols)) |>
    arrange(gear_class, across(all_of(key_cols[[tm]][1])), cell_id)
  f <- file.path(paths$analysis, sprintf("%s_%s_gear.csv", ds, tm))
  write_csv(out, f, na = "")
  stopifnot("static covariates missing after the join" = !anyNA(select(out, all_of(static_cols))),
            "infrastructure covariates missing after the join" =
              !anyNA(select(out, any_of(c("phase", "active_construction", "active_construction_share")))))
  write_provenance(f, c(inputs_of(ds), paths$leases, paths$bathy,
                        if (tm %in% names(infra_by_step)) c(paths$infra, infra_inputs)), extra = list(
    dataset = ds, time_step = tm, set = "primary", pull_date = pull_date,
    rows = nrow(out), columns = names(out)))
  written <- add_row(written, file = basename(f), rows = nrow(out))
}

cells <- grid |>
  select(cell_id, ix, iy, area_km2, aoi_frac, aoi_class) |>
  left_join(select(grid_attr, cell_id, x_km, y_km), by = "cell_id") |>
  left_join(cell_dist, by = "cell_id") |>
  left_join(domain_wide, by = "cell_id") |>
  left_join(bathy_cells, by = "cell_id") |>
  left_join(infra_static, by = "cell_id") |>
  mutate(dist_band = as.character(dist_band))
f_cells <- file.path(paths$analysis, "cells.gpkg")
st_write(cells, f_cells, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
write_provenance(f_cells, c(paths$grid, paths$leases, paths$bathy, paths$infra,
                            unlist(map(datasets, inputs_of))),
                 extra = list(rows = nrow(cells), crs = "EPSG:32619",
                              columns = names(st_drop_geometry(cells)),
                              dist_band_reference = "8-15"))

# infrastructure covariates on their own, one row per cell × step (no gear),
# for models and plots that need exposure without the effort tables
infra_out <- list(
  infra_cell_month = infra_month,
  infra_cell_season_year = infra_season_year,
  infra_cell_month_srw_planned = infra_month_srw)
for (nm in names(infra_out)) {
  f <- file.path(paths$analysis, paste0(nm, ".csv"))
  write_csv(round_written(infra_out[[nm]]), f, na = "")
  write_provenance(f, c(paths$infra, infra_inputs, paths$grid, paths$leases), extra = list(
    rows = nrow(infra_out[[nm]]), r_count_km = qparams$r_count_km,
    r_active_km = qparams$r_active_km, r_cable_km = qparams$r_cable_km,
    srw_planned = if (nm == "infra_cell_month_srw_planned")
      paste("40 unrecorded SRW positions installed", qparams$srw_planned_from) else "planned, never installed"))
  written <- add_row(written, file = basename(f), rows = nrow(infra_out[[nm]]))
}

# weights: GAL with cell_id as the region id, plus the R objects
f_gal <- file.path(paths$analysis, "grid_queen.gal")
write.nb.gal(nb_poly, f_gal, oldstyle = FALSE, shpfile = "cells", ind = "cell_id")
write_provenance(f_gal, paths$grid, extra = list(type = "queen contiguity",
                 region_id = "cell_id, in cells.gpkg row order"))
f_w <- file.path(paths$analysis, "grid_weights.rds")
saveRDS(list(nb = nb_poly, lw_W = lw_W, lw_B_self = lw_B_self, cell_id = grid$cell_id), f_w)
write_provenance(f_w, paths$grid, extra = list(
  objects = c("nb: queen nb", "lw_W: row-standardised", "lw_B_self: binary, self-included"),
  spdep = as.character(packageVersion("spdep"))))

written
```

## Gate

Hours in each analysis table equal hours in 04's interim table per gear ×
time step; the stage × season and season-year tables sum to the monthly
totals; no stratum spans two stages; the tables have one row per cell for
every stratum; the weights and covariates pass their checks; and the
infrastructure layers match their sources (counts, positions within 100 m,
dates in the window, every foundation in its own lease), with exposure that
only grows as foundations go in.

```{r}
interim_total <- function(ds, tm) {
  interim[[ds]][[tm]] |> filter(set == "primary", gear_class %in% analysis_gears) |>
    mutate(stage = if (tm == "stage") `Development Stage` else stage_of(`Year Month`)) |>
    group_by(gear_class, stage) |> summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop")
}

for (ds in datasets) {
  ref <- interim_total(ds, "stage")
  ref_m <- interim_total(ds, "month")
  check(sprintf("%s: interim stage and month tables agree by gear × stage", ds),
        isTRUE(all.equal(ref$hours, ref_m$hours)))
  for (tm in names(key_cols)) {
    got <- analysis[[ds]][[tm]] |> group_by(gear_class, stage) |>
      summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop") |>
      right_join(ref, by = c("gear_class", "stage"))
    check(sprintf("%s %s: hours = interim, per gear × stage", ds, tm),
          isTRUE(all.equal(got$hours.x, got$hours.y)))
  }
  n_strata <- c(stage = nrow(months_stage), stage_season = nrow(months_stage_season),
                season_year = nrow(months_season_year), month = nrow(calendar))
  for (tm in names(n_strata)) {
    t <- analysis[[ds]][[tm]]
    check(sprintf("%s %s: one row per cell × stratum × gear", ds, tm),
          nrow(t) == nrow(grid) * n_strata[[tm]] * length(analysis_gears) &&
            !anyNA(select(t, -any_of(c("y_vst", "rate_fleet", "rate_std")))))
  }
}

gate |> mutate(pass = if_else(pass, "pass", "FAIL")) |> knitr::kable()

stopifnot("Phase 0 gate failed; see the table above" = all(gate$pass))
```
